verdict_reason: Fixture rename to commodityCode/speciesLatinName is correct, but the line fixture uses an array species shape production never stores and is duplicated in collection-complete.test.js.

todos.issue: The completeLine fixture is not a line the app can store. Line 10 sets speciesLatinName: ['Bos taurus'] (an array carried over from the old speciesSelection id list), but seedLine in commit-selection.js and fixtures/happy-path.json store speciesLatinName as one string, and species-entry.js sends it to the backend as a scalar value/text. Line 13 also gives the cattle unit a permanentAddress, which the permanentAddress obligation only asks for on the PERMANENT_ADDRESS_SPECIES Latin names (cat, dog, ferret), so it is dead set-up that suggests cattle need it. The 'complete' assertions on lines 37 and 50 pass on a shape production never writes.
todos.fix: Must: completeLine has the shape seedLine writes (speciesLatinName a single string, commodityType from typeIdFor) and carries only answers the obligations ask for on a 0102 line. One way: set speciesLatinName: 'Bos taurus' and drop permanentAddress from the unit, or build the line with seedLine plus the answers the details pages add.

todos.issue: The address, completeLine and incomplete line fixtures (lines 5-17) are copied in src/server/app/bridge/collection-complete.test.js (address, completeLine, partialLine at lines 13-37), and this PR edited both copies in step to move from commoditySelection/speciesSelection to commodityCode/speciesLatinName. Set-up used by two tests belongs in a shared helper; the next shape change has to be made twice again.
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper owns the complete and incomplete commodity-line fixtures, and both collection-view.test.js and collection-complete.test.js import them with no local copies left. One way: export completeCommodityLine and incompleteCommodityLine from engine/test-support.js (or a commodity-line fixture module beside it) and import them in both tests.
